steps.text: Choose whether to enable or disable biometrics from the settings screen.

options.action: Tap on the blue toggle next to 'Enable Biometrics'.
options.result: A success message will be displayed indicating that biometrics has been disabled.

options.action: Tap on the grey toggle next to 'Enable Biometrics'.
options.result: A success message will be displayed indicating that biometrics has been enabled.
